title: Stop mid-turn

steps.post: @{agent} read every monthly minutes page linked from {FIX}/minutes/ one page at a time, and give me a table of every month's approved expenditure.

groundTruth.spec: §7.5 stop aborts current turns at the next iteration boundary: no further tool calls, an in-flight action may finish; it posts visibly; a pending approval is cancelled; the queue is not cleared

pass: After the stop, the turn made no further tool call (the last tool_result event precedes the stop's timestamp or is the one in flight); the status post ends with a stopped marker and the channel shows the stop notice; the turn's Turn row status is the stop status; no reply claims the table was finished; the queue listing is empty.

checks.text: events.json: no tool call started after the stop notice's create_at; at most one result arrived after it.
The status post's first line is a stopped marker (⏹️ or ⏸️) and the system bot posted a stop notice in the channel.
turns.json status names the stop; if the model posted anything after, it does not claim completion.
The /collegium queue note in driver.json shows nothing queued.
